find: devCfgGeneration += 1; // and a Configuration load still in flight builds nothing (issue #1015)
killedBy: the Configuration body loads when its pane first opens (issue #1015) a teardown during the load builds nothing into the discarded tree
why: Issue #1015. Teardown stops spending the Configuration load's generation. `dispose` runs neither the pane's close nor a surface change, so a load still in flight builds the body, and the 14 listeners the menu puts on it, into the tree the teardown discarded.
